Text_ExplosionTeach:
Can you imagine? If this volcano were to erupt?
The explosion would be the end of us. How terrifying is that?
While we're terrified, would you like me to teach EXPLOSION?
Text_ExplosionDeclined: Yeah, you're right. It is too terrifying.
Text_ExplosionWhichMon:
You're terribly brave!
Which POKéMON should I teach EXPLOSION?
Text_ExplosionTaught:
Using EXPLOSION while on this volcano…
What a terrifying thrill!

MtEmber_Exterior_Text_WellTryDiggingHere:
Over here. We'll try digging here.
That treasure the ADMINS've been talking about should be here.
MtEmber_Exterior_Text_YoureInTheWayGetLo: What the…? You're in the way. Get lost.
MtEmber_Exterior_Text_PunchedThroughAtLa: Whew, punched through at last. Let's go treasure hunting!
MtEmber_Exterior_Text_WhatsPasswordAgain:
Any treasure we find, we haul back to the WAREHOUSE, understood?
…Oh, and what're the passwords? At the ROCKET WAREHOUSE, I mean.
MtEmber_Exterior_Text_FirstPasswordGolde:
What, you forgot the password? There're actually two.
The first one's “GOLDEEN need log.”
And the second one is…
MtEmber_Exterior_Text_SnoopsBeenListenin: Hey! This snoop's been listening in!
MtEmber_Exterior_Text_Grunt1Intro: You've been eavesdropping on us, haven't you?
MtEmber_Exterior_Text_Grunt2Intro: Trying to horn in on our treasure? Don't bet on it!
MtEmber_Exterior_Text_Grunt2PostBattle: Develop amnesia conveniently and forget everything you heard!
MtEmber_Exterior_Text_WellRegroupDontSte:
What a setback… We'll have to regroup.
You! Don't even think about taking a step inside here!
If you know what's good for you, don't even think about this!
MtEmber_Exterior_Text_LoganIntro: An active volcano is one that's erupting, or about to.
MtEmber_Exterior_Text_LoganDefeat: Whew… That was hot! Sweat's erupting from me!
MtEmber_Exterior_Text_LoganPostBattle:
They say there're over 1,500 active volcanoes in the world.
Just thinking about them makes me feel all hot and gooey inside!
MtEmber_Exterior_Text_BethIntro: Do you know how caves form inside volcanoes?
MtEmber_Exterior_Text_BethPostBattle: When lava at the surface of magma hardens, and the magma inside flows out, caverns are left behind.
MtEmber_Exterior_Text_JocelynIntro:
I've been in training so I can mend my broken heart…
It toughened me up physically at least! Hi-yah!
MtEmber_Exterior_Text_JocelynDefeat: I think I tried to overdo it…
MtEmber_Exterior_Text_JocelynPostBattle: The way you battle, it reminds me of the guy who dumped me…
